Between save and restore nothing writes &02 &03 &7E &7F &80 &82 &83 &84 &8E &8F &94 &95 &9B: static grep of every source for ST*/INC/DEC/shift/TSB/TRB to those addresses or their zp.6502 names finds only front-end code (bank5, front_gameplay), logic-side shield.6502/shield_hi.6502 (player_dead/respawn under main_game_loop) and game.6502 logic routines; dynamic ZPWATCH of exactly these 13 addresses over a whole-world worldrun on build/strykers.ssd (23,072 game fields, 11,412 renders) shows every game-phase write from logic routines (found_topmost_mover, update_player, start_jump, clear_screen, initialise_*, start_game...) and from restore_game_zp itself, none from any render-phase code. SKIP 65 = 13 x 5 bytes keeps the tail and everything after at the same address (padding is before the label, never executed). Cycles 13 x (LDA abs 4 + STA zp 3) = 91 per render (once a pass); bytes 0.
